description: Analyze any text for keyword density: total words, keyword count, density percentage and a top-10 word frequency table. Paste text or fetch a page URL.

faqs.a: The percentage of times a keyword appears relative to the total word count of the text.
Around 1–2% is generally considered natural. Stuffing keywords can hurt rankings instead of helping.
faqs.q: What is a good keyword density?

faqs.a: Most websites block cross-origin fetching (CORS). When that happens, copy the page text and paste it into the text box instead.
faqs.q: Why did the URL fetch fail?

howto: Enter the keyword or phrase you want to measure.
Paste your article text, or enter a page URL and click Fetch & Load Text.
Click Analyze to compute the real density statistics.
Review the top-10 word frequency table for optimization ideas.
title: Keyword Density Checker
